Subject: FinLytics POC: outcomes digest + quick advocacy ask

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us. We pulled together a short outcomes digest (attached) and a dashboard snapshot — key highlights below:

- Latency: 95th percentile latency for inference went from ~420ms -> 190ms (55% reduction) for your peak batch profile.
- Cost: estimated per-inference compute cost down ~62% after batching + KV caching.
- Throughput: sustainable throughput improved ~3.2x under the same fleet allocation.
- Query quality: intent-match rate in sampling tests held steady at 94% (no meaningful degradation after quantization).

Monica and Marissa are cc'd — Monica so CS can confirm the production rollout plan, Marissa so marketing can scope a short outcomes blurb if you're comfortable.

Quick ask: would you be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in a short case highlight, and separately hop on a 15-minute recorded call next week so we can capture a line or two on the business impact (we'd only use audio/transcript with your consent)? We won't publish anything until you sign off on the language.

If it helps, suggested time slots: Wed 11/4 10:00–10:30 PT, Thu 11/5 14:00–14:30 PT, or Tue 11/10 09:00–09:30 PT.

Attached: FinLytics_POC_one-pager.pdf, inference_dashboard_snapshot.png

Thanks — appreciate the collaboration and the great results.

Best,
Karthik
